title: Preserve polite chat file creation commands
goal: Preserve explicit file-create commands when chat adds common polite lead-ins so the workspace parser receives a valid command.
context: Confirmed source defect: chatInputText only recognized direct file-create prefixes and could strip command text before parseCreateFileRequest.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass workspace policy, scope checks, or the explicit create-file parser.
Do not change unrelated Skills or provider behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Common allowlisted polite lead-ins are removed only when followed by an explicit supported file-create prefix.
Ordinary prompts retain existing normalization behavior.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
Regression tests cover polite lead-ins for Vietnamese and English file-create commands while ordinary colon prompts retain prior behavior.
verification: M3 and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI
recovery: Revert this task if parser or policy regressions occur; keep CI failure evidence.
